item.title: Re: CONTEST RESULTS
item.content:encoded:
Just… wow. I'm stunned. Going into this contest I never, ever expected to win in any category, let alone in two of them - I actually re-read the contest results twice to make sure I wasn't somehow mistaken. This definitely made my day week month!

I'd like to say congrats to all the winners and participants, and many, many thanks to Roget and the judges for spending so many hours on this. This contest was a lot of fun, and I enjoyed the opportunity to get back into making art, which is a hobby of mine I'd been neglecting these last few years. :)

item.title: CONTEST RESULTS
item.content:encoded:
Hey! Results are in!

Special twist: I have decided to award two spots to the SCP categories, due to the large number of entries and the presence of ties. Their images will be placed at the bottom of the series pages!

THE WINNERS ARE:

SERIES I

SCP-120, by Hercules Rockafeller! This also wins BEST IN SHOW which is mostly for bragging rights and brownie points.

SCP-001 by Zhange!

SERIES II

SCP-1958 by Hercules Rockafeller!

SCP-1177 by Piperfrog!

SERIES III

SCP-2146 by Amaridori!

SCP-2256 by Darkgreeny!

SERIES IV

Red Reality by Bluernoon

SCP-3005 by Monkeyclone!

Characters

Dr. Gears by Shiro!

MTF

Mobile Task Forces by Yugoproductions!

Groups of Interest

Church of the Broken God by Zhange!

Tales

Bellerverse by DrFrog!

I want to give a personal thanks to all of our artists for producing such a tremendous amount of quality artwork. That's the reason its taken so long to get these results, the logistical process to get this all together was at times very trying. But all of it was done in a good way, and I hope it is some comfort that it was your enthusiasm and productivity which felled us logistically. What power you all wield! Your patience over these past 145 days has been nothing short of remarkable and I hope you can all forgive me for the delay.

What happens now?

Judge comments and full art galleries of all the entries are on the way, I'm going to be consulting with the Tech Team on the best possible way to get the images up in a visually pleasing way. I've burned myself and you guys with putting specific deadlines on things so I'm just going to leave that as "to be done as soon as possible".

See you all soon!

item.title: Re: An Explanation, An Apology, and Gratitude
item.content:encoded: No worries. Organising a contest is a difficult task, especially since there has been no precedent for an art-themed one before on the site. Thank you to all the previous judges for giving it your best, and good luck to the new panel.

item.title: An Explanation, An Apology, and Gratitude
item.content:encoded:
Hello folks!

So you may have noticed that this judging period has been dragging on quite some time. I take responsibility for this, I did not anticipate the great magnitude of artwork we would be given and my judging panel fell apart due to a lack of proper expectation and preparation. I should have done more to help them prepare and try more to keep them accountable, so I sincerely apologize to the artists who have been waiting so patiently for us to get our shit together.

A new panel of judges has been created and they are working on getting through all the content. I don't want to put a hard date on when they'll be done but I hope it will be before the end of the year, and the period over which the artworks will be displayed will be correspondingly lengthened. The identity of the previous judges will remain anonymous and they take no blame for this, the task placed before them was monumental and I should have been responsible for giving them proper preparations.

That being said, I want to give my sincerest thanks to everyone who participated in this contest, your massive efforts are incredibly impressive and I hope that you can all take some comfort in that your blowing away all of our expectations is a crucial cause of what is taking so long.

So, again, apologies, and we are working on it. Stay tuned.

- Roget

item.content:encoded: IMO voting wouldn't be effective for this contest. I'm personally content to wait for the judges as I trust them to vote based on the actual quality of the entries.
